rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it for no cost.)

rulesText:

rulesText: Your opponent chooses one of your shields. Look at it. If it's a spell, you may cast immediately for no cost. If it's not a spell or if you don't cast it, put it back where it was.
flavorText: "This is even more fun that Cosmic Tic-Tac-Toe!" — Pharzi, the Oracle

name: Typhoon Crawler
rulesText: This creature can't be attacked by fire or nature creatures.
flavorText: "If you go outside, bring a raincoat, an umbrella, and an anchor." — Wise Starnoid, Avatar of Hope

name: Meloppe
rulesText:
Whenever your opponent would choose one of your shields, you choose instead.
Whenever you would choose one of your opponent's shields, your opponent chooses instead.
flavorText: "That's not a pacifier, it's a brain stem interface. With a handle. That I suck on."

name: Gigavrand
rulesText: At the end of each turn, if your opponent drew 2 or more cards that turn, he discards his hand.
flavorText: "The specimen is particularly ruthless. Tests have shown that it has no 'ruth' whatsoever." — Meloppe

rulesText: Wave striker (While 2 or more other creatures in the battle zone have "wave striker," this creature has its Wave striker ability.) : When this creature is put into battle Zone, destroy all creatures.

name: Mechadragon's Breath
rulesText: Choose a number less than or equal to 6000. Destroy all creatures that have that power.
flavorText: "Yes! After three long years of neverending work, my invention is a complete success! Now we can finally start the barbecue!" — Rikabu, the Dismantler

flavorText: "The worst news can turn out to be the best news. Once you're at the bottom of the waterfall, there's nowhere you can fall from there." — Meloppe

rulesText:
Shield Trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)

name: Cloned Spike-Horn
rulesText:
This creature gets +3000 power for each Cloned Spike-Horn in each graveyard.
While this creature has power 6000 or more, it has "double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields)."

name: Electro Explorer Syrion
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)

name: Sea Mutant Dormel
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)

name: Gigappi Ponto
rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)

rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)

rulesText: (This creature is put into your mana zone tapped.)

rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you opponent discards a card at random from his hand.
